text: Praise ye Jah. Praise ye God in his holy place: praise him in the firmament of his power.
Praise ye him in his powers: praise him according to the multitude of his greatness.
Praise ye him with the clangor of the trumpet: praise him with the lyre and the harp.
Praise him with the drum and the dance: praise ye him with strings and the pipe.
Praise ye him with ringing instruments of hearing: praise him with ringing instruments of loud noise.
All breath shall praise Jah. Praise ye Jah.
